sound_historical_observations: Checksummed connector endpoint/curve observations and rest/ledger evidence remain useful reproduction leads at their recorded source IDs and frames.
No projected or authored fingering occurs in retained root fixtures, so those old failures cannot be attributed to instructional numbers.
